title: Manfaat Daun Katuk
notes: Teks VO memakai tag emosi eleven_v3 ([curious], [excited], ...). '|' = batas halaman subtitle (dibuang sebelum TTS). Subtitle EN punya jumlah halaman yang sama dengan ID per adegan.
facts_source: Data Komposisi Pangan Indonesia (Kemenkes RI), per 100 g

scenes.vo: [curious] Jeruk... | atau daun ini? | [curious] Mana yang vitamin C-nya | lebih banyak?
scenes.en: Orange... | or this leaf? | Which one has | more vitamin C?

scenes.vo: [excited] Jawabannya... | DAUN INI! | [excited] Vitamin C-nya | tiga kali lipat jeruk!
scenes.en: The answer... | THIS LEAF! | Its vitamin C is | 3x an orange's!

scenes.vo: [warm] Kenalin, daun katuk. | Sering dicuekin... | [excited] padahal gizinya | padat banget! | [whispers] Tapi ada satu hal | yang wajib kamu tahu... | nanti di akhir.
scenes.en: Meet katuk leaves. | Often ignored... | yet they're | packed with nutrients! | But there's one thing | you must know... | at the end.

scenes.vo: Pertama: | sahabat ibu menyusui! | Dari zaman nenek, | katuk dipercaya | bikin ASI lancar... | [excited] dan beberapa penelitian bilang, | hasilnya menjanjikan!
scenes.en: First: | a nursing mom's best friend! | Since grandma's time, | katuk has been believed | to boost breast milk... | and some studies say | the results are promising!

scenes.vo: Kedua: | kalsiumnya lebih tinggi dari... | [surprised] susu sapi! | [laughs] Iya, susu!
scenes.en: Second: | its calcium beats... | cow's milk! | Yes, milk!

scenes.vo: Ketiga: | karotenoidnya | hampir nyamain wortel. | Bagus buat mata!
scenes.en: Third: | its carotenoids | almost match carrots. | Good for your eyes!

scenes.vo: Keempat: | zat besinya setara bayam. | [mischievously] Jadi kalau bosan bayam... | nih, cadangannya!
scenes.en: Fourth: | its iron equals spinach. | So if you're bored of spinach... | here's your backup!

scenes.vo: [serious] Nah, | ini yang wajib kamu tahu. | Tahun sembilan puluhan di Taiwan, | sempat tren diet | jus daun katuk mentah. | [curious] Hasilnya? | [dramatically] Banyak yang kena | gangguan paru-paru serius! | [serious] Jadi: masak dulu, | jangan berlebihan.
scenes.en: Now, | here's what you must know. | In 1990s Taiwan, | a diet trend spread: | raw katuk leaf juice. | The result? | Many people got | serious lung problems! | So: cook it first, | and don't overdo it.

scenes.vo: [excited] Murah, gampang ditanam, | kaya manfaat! | [playful] Kirim video ini ke temanmu | yang masih pilih jeruk!
scenes.en: Cheap, easy to grow, | full of benefits! | Send this to a friend | who still picks oranges!
